text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Energy Minister Abdellatif Guerraoui pleads for the privatisation of mining sector.
- Interior ministry delegation invited to the United States to attend presidential elections proceedings.
- Morocco marks 21st anniversary of King Hassan's decision to undertake the Green March to Western Sahara.
- Members of main unions visit Germany in attempt to boost investments in Morocco.
- Visiting Eritrean Foreign Minister Petros Solomon says he seeks closer cooperation with Morocco.
- Venezuela plans to open embassy in Morocco.
- EU increases visits to Morocco because of security fears over illegal immigration and drug trafficking.
- Police crush demonstration of more than 1,200 jobless graduates.
